note: Native hidden-field prompts, one table per OS family, named as envrec_os.family() names it (darwin, linux, windows). The value is typed into the operating system's own window on the owner's computer: it never goes through a chat or a model. `result` says how to read the answer; `value_prefix` is stripped from the output; `rc` maps an exit code to an outcome when the tool uses exit codes. UNTESTED on Windows and Linux.

argv:
on run argv
  set t to item 1 of argv
  set m to item 2 of argv
  set secs to (item 3 of argv) as integer
  try
    set r to display dialog m with title t default answer "" with hidden answer buttons {"Cancel", "Store"} default button "Store" cancel button "Cancel" with icon caution giving up after secs
    if gave up of r then return "timeout"
    return "value:" & (text returned of r)
  on error
    return "declined"
  end try
end run
